metadata.title: Secure Collaboration Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing the institutional Secure Collaboration Platform, providing unified governance, trust assurance, and lifecycle control for all digital collaboration services.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure Collaboration Platform provides institutionally governed digital collaboration services, including messaging, conferencing, presence, file sharing, and persistent workspaces, with consistent identity attribution, boundary control, and accountability.

props.name: platform-role
props.remarks: Secure Collaboration is a Tier-1 institutional platform supporting instruction, research, and operational coordination.

props.name: implements-pattern
props.remarks: This SSPP is the authoritative implementation and assurance anchor for the Secure Collaboration composite pattern.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Collaboration relies on Secure Identity for authentication, attribution, delegation, and identity lifecycle management.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Collaboration relies on Secure Network for trusted transport, session protection, segmentation, monitoring, and resiliency.

props.name: collaboration-trust-model
props.remarks: Collaboration trust is explicit, identity-bound, session-scoped, and does not persist beyond defined membership or lifecycle boundaries.

props.name: external-participation
props.remarks: External or federated participants may be permitted only where explicitly authorized and observable.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: The Secure Collaboration Platform aligns with NIST SP 800-58 guidance for securing real-time voice and multimedia communication.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Remote and unmanaged endpoints participating in collaboration services are governed in accordance with SP 800-46.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Cross-organizational and federated collaboration scenarios align with SP 800-47 trust-boundary and responsibility guidance.

system-implementation.remarks: The Secure Collaboration Platform composes multiple collaboration modalities under a unified governance, identity, and observability framework.

roles.title: Collaboration Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Defines collaboration platform architecture, trust boundaries, and SSPP inheritance rules.

roles.title: Collaboration Operations
roles.remarks: Operates collaboration services in accordance with platform governance.

roles.title: Collaboration Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors collaboration activity, detects misuse, and coordinates response.

control-implementation.remarks: Security and privacy controls are implemented through inherited Secure Identity, Secure Network, and collaboration modality SSPPs. This SSPP documents governance, scope, and assurance only.
